# --- 1) Calculate GO cosine similarity of the MEF2C (+) regulon --- #

```{r GO_similarity}
mef2c_genes <- df_network_data %>% 
    unnest(cols = c(data)) %>%
    filter(module == "MEF2C_+_+") %>% 
    pull(gene_name) %>% 
    unique()

# GO cosine similarity among these genes (BP ontology; identical build to GR/MORPH)
mef2c_net <- build_go_network(
    mef2c_genes,
    go_mapping = go_mapping %>% filter(ontology == "BP"),
    gene_stats = df_asd_rarevar_zscore
)

# Save the network object for plotting in Fig4
saveRDS(mef2c_net, file = file.path(notebook_out_dir, "04_02_MEF2C-GO-similarity-graph.RDS"))
```


# --- 2) Run SynGO enrichment on MEF2C (+) --- #

```{r SynGO_ORA}
# Extrat MEF2C gene IDs
mef2c_gene_ids <- df_network_data %>% 
    unnest(cols = c(data)) %>%
    filter(module == "MEF2C_+_+") %>% 
    pull(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
    unique()

# Extract Wang study background
wang_background <- df_network_data %>% 
    unnest(cols = c(data)) %>% 
    filter(study == "Wang") %>% 
    pull(ensembl_gene_id) %>% 
    unique()

# Convert SynGO tibble to a list of pathways. ensembl_id is a comma-space-delimited
# string of gene IDs per term, so split it to one gene per row before grouping.
syngo_genes_list <- df_syngo_ontol %>%
    dplyr::select(id, ensembl_id) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ensembl_id)) %>%
    separate_rows(ensembl_id, sep = ", ") %>%
    mutate(ensembl_id = str_trim(ensembl_id)) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(unique(ensembl_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(lengths(genes) >= 5 & lengths(genes) <= 1000) %>% # drop very small / very broad terms (matches 02_00)
    deframe()

# SynGO background: every gene annotated to any SynGO term (the list2 universe)
syngo_background <- df_syngo_ontol %>%
    dplyr::select(ensembl_id) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ensembl_id)) %>%
    separate_rows(ensembl_id, sep = ", ") %>%
    mutate(ensembl_id = str_trim(ensembl_id)) %>%
    pull(ensembl_id) %>%
    unique()

# Only test SynGO terms the regulon overlaps by > 1 gene (same pre-filter as 02_00)
syngo_tested <- syngo_genes_list[
    map_lgl(syngo_genes_list, ~ length(intersect(.x, mef2c_gene_ids)) > 1)
]

# ORA: MEF2C (+) regulon vs each overlapping SynGO term (Fisher's exact, one-sided
# over-representation). Universe = Wang study network ∩ SynGO, same call as the 02_00 run.
df_syngo_res <- imap_dfr(syngo_tested, ~
    ORA_fisher(
        gene_list1       = mef2c_gene_ids,
        gene_list2       = .x,
        background_list1 = wang_background,
        background_list2 = syngo_background,
        alternative      = "greater"
    ) %>%
        mutate(module = "MEF2C_+_+", go_id = .y)
)

# Format: attach term name/domain, BH-correct across tested terms, add % of regulon overlapping
df_syngo_res <- df_syngo_res %>%
    left_join(df_syngo_ontol %>% dplyr::select(go_id = id, term = name, domain),
              by = "go_id") %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"), .before = n_overlap) %>%
    dplyr::rename(n_module = n_list1, n_pathway = n_list2) %>%
    mutate(pct_module = n_overlap / n_module * 100) %>%
    dplyr::select(module, go_id, term, domain, everything()) %>%
    arrange(p_value)

# Save the object for plotting in Fig4
saveRDS(df_syngo_res, file = file.path(notebook_out_dir, "04_02_MEF2C-SynGO-enrichment.RDS"))
```


# --- 3) MEF2C (+) PPI data --- #

## 5.1 STRINGdb setup

```{r stringdb_setup}
string_db <- STRINGdb$new(
    version        = "12",
    species        = 9606,
    score_threshold = 400,
    network_type   = "physical",
    input_directory = ""
)
```

## 5.2 Retrieve PPI data for MEF2C (+)

Helper function

```{r get_ppi_data_function}
get_module_ppi_data <- function(mod_name,
                                string_db,
                                df_network = df_network_data,
                                df_kme     = df_module_kme,
                                df_asd     = df_asd_rarevar_zscore) {

    print(paste0("Getting PPI for ", mod_name))

    # 1. Base gene list for the module
    genes_in_mod <- df_network %>%
        unnest(cols = c(data)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        filter(module == mod_name) %>%
        filter(!is.na(ensembl_gene_id)) %>%
        dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, gene_name) %>%
        distinct()

    # 2. Node preparation
    coexp_modules <- df_kme %>% pull(module) %>% unique
    if (mod_name %in% coexp_modules) {
        nodes <- df_kme %>%
            filter(module == mod_name & kME_module == mod_name) %>%
            dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, gene_name, kME) %>%
            distinct() %>%
            arrange(-kME) %>%
            mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
            left_join(df_asd %>% dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, FDR, contains("BF")),
                      by = "ensembl_gene_id")
    } else {
        nodes <- genes_in_mod %>%
            left_join(df_asd %>% dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, FDR, contains("BF")),
                      by = "ensembl_gene_id") %>%
            mutate(rank = 999, kME = NA)
    }

    # 3. Map to STRING
    mapped <- string_db$map(as.data.frame(nodes), "ensembl_gene_id", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)

    # 4. Extract edges
    edges_raw <- string_db$get_interactions(mapped$STRING_id)

    # 5. Format edges
    edges <- as_tibble(edges_raw) %>%
        left_join(mapped %>% dplyr::rename_all(~paste0("from_", .x)),
                  by = join_by(from == from_STRING_id)) %>%
        left_join(mapped %>% dplyr::rename_all(~paste0("to_", .x)),
                  by = join_by(to == to_STRING_id)) %>%
        dplyr::select(contains("ensembl_gene_id"), combined_score) %>%
        distinct() %>%
        mutate(confidence = case_when(
            combined_score >= 900 ~ "Very High (>0.9)",
            combined_score >= 700 ~ "High (0.7-0.9)",
            TRUE                  ~ "Medium (0.4-0.7)"
        )) %>%
        mutate(confidence = factor(confidence,
                                   levels = c("Very High (>0.9)", "High (0.7-0.9)", "Medium (0.4-0.7)")))

    return(list(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, module = mod_name))
}
```

Run on MEF2C (+)

```{r run_ppi_data}
ppi_data_results <- map(list("MEF2C_+_+"), ~{
    get_module_ppi_data(.x, string_db, df_network_data, df_module_kme, df_asd_rarevar_zscore)
})

# Save output as RDS file
saveRDS(
    ppi_data_results[[1]],
    file = file.path(notebook_out_dir, "04_02_MEF2C-PPI.RDS")
)
```


# --- 4) Supplement plots --- #

## 4.1 MEF2C (+) PPI plot

Helper function

```{r plot_ppi_function}
plot_module_ppi <- function(ppi_list,
                            min_confidence = 700,
                            max_BF,
                            genes_to_label = NULL,
                            genes_to_bold = NULL,
                            n_top_genes_to_label = 10,
                            legend = FALSE,
                            seed = 234) {

    # 1. Create graph object
    graph <- tbl_graph(
        nodes    = ppi_list$nodes,
        edges    = ppi_list$edges %>% filter(combined_score >= min_confidence),
        node_key = "ensembl_gene_id",
        directed = FALSE
    ) %>%
        activate(nodes) %>%
        arrange(FDR) %>%
        mutate(asd_rank = row_number()) %>%
        # GO topic from the section-1 gene–topic assignment (NA for non-risk interactors)
        mutate(GO_topic = df_gene_assignments$GO_topic[match(gene_name, df_gene_assignments$gene_name)]) %>%
        # de-emphasize the non-topic (non-risk) interactors: fade and shrink them
        mutate(node_alpha = if_else(is.na(GO_topic), 0.35, 1),
               node_size  = if_else(is.na(GO_topic), 0,    log_BF)) %>%
        mutate(label = case_when(
            asd_rank <= n_top_genes_to_label ~ gene_name,
            gene_name %in% genes_to_label    ~ gene_name,
            TRUE                             ~ ""
        )) %>%
        arrange(log_BF) %>%
        filter(!node_is_isolated() | label != "")

    # 2. Keep only subclusters containing at least one ASD risk gene (FDR < 0.001)
    graph_filtered <- graph %>%
        mutate(comp_id = group_components()) %>%
        group_by(comp_id) %>%
        filter(any(FDR < 0.001)) %>%
        ungroup()

    # 3. Plot
    set.seed(seed)
    p <- ggraph(graph_filtered, layout = "fr") +
        # all edges uniform (PPI confidence distinction is too subtle to be meaningful at this size)
        geom_edge_link(edge_width = 0.2, color = "gray85", alpha = 0.5) +
        # geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = confidence, color = confidence), alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_node_point(aes(fill   = GO_topic,
                            size   = node_size,
                            alpha  = node_alpha,
                            stroke = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.001
                            ),
                        color = "gray20",
                        shape = 21) +
        scale_alpha_identity() +
        geom_node_text(aes(label    = label,
                           fontface = if_else(label %in% genes_to_bold, "bold", "plain")),
                       size = 1.6, vjust = -0.8) +

        # scale_edge_width_manual(
        #     values = c("Very High (>0.9)" = 0.4, "High (0.7-0.9)" = 0.2, "Medium (0.4-0.7)" = 0.08),
        #     name   = "PPI Confidence"
        # ) +
        # scale_edge_color_manual(
        #     values = c("Very High (>0.9)" = "gray78", "High (0.7-0.9)" = "gray85", "Medium (0.4-0.7)" = "gray92"),
        #     name   = "PPI Confidence"
        # ) +
        scale_discrete_manual(aesthetics = "stroke",
                              values = c("TRUE" = 0.5, "FALSE" = 0.25),
                              name   = "TADA FDR < 0.001",
                              guide = "none"
                              ) +
        # scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "gray20", "FALSE" = "gray20"),
        #                    name   = "TADA FDR < 0.001"
        #                    ) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(topic_colors, "NA (TADA FDR > 0.001)" = "gray50"),
                          name   = "GO topic") +
        scale_size_continuous(range  = c(1, 4),
                              limits = c(0, max_BF),
                              name   = "log10(BF)") +
        guides(
            size          = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
            fill          = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
        ) +
        coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
        theme_void() +
        labs(title = NULL) +
        theme(
            plot.title            = element_blank(),
            plot.margin           = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
            legend.position       = "bottom",
            legend.box            = "vertical",
            legend.title.position = "top",
            legend.title          = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 6),
            legend.text           = element_text(margin = margin(l = -1), size = 5.5),
            legend.key.height     = unit(0.3, "cm"),
            legend.spacing        = unit(0.15, "cm"),
            legend.box.just       = "bottom",
            legend.margin         = margin(l = -10)
        )

    if (!legend) { p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none") }
    return(p)
}
```

```{r run_plot_ppi, fig.height = 3, fig.width = 3}
## Identify genes to label (risk genes in MEF2C + >= 1 high confidence PPI interaction)
mef2c_asd_genes <- intersect(
    df_asd_rarevar_zscore %>% filter(FDR < 0.001) %>% pull(gene_name),
    df_network_data %>% unnest(cols = c(data)) %>% filter(module == "MEF2C_+_+") %>% pull(gene_name)
) %>% unique

ppi_asd_genes <- intersect(
    df_asd_rarevar_zscore %>% filter(FDR < 0.001) %>% pull(ensembl_gene_id),
    c(ppi_data_results[[1]]$edges %>% filter(combined_score > 700) %>% pull(from_ensembl_gene_id),
      ppi_data_results[[1]]$edges %>% filter(combined_score > 700) %>% pull(to_ensembl_gene_id))
) %>% unique

mef2c_genes_to_label <- df_asd_rarevar_zscore %>% 
    filter(
        (gene_name %in% mef2c_asd_genes &
            ensembl_gene_id %in% ppi_asd_genes) |
            gene_name == "MEF2C"
    ) %>% 
    pull(gene_name) %>% 
    unique

## Generate plot
ppi_plots <- map(
    ppi_data_results,
    ~ plot_module_ppi(
        .x,
        min_confidence       = 700,
        max_BF               = 133,
        # genes_to_label       = c(cmu_prs_genes, cmu_pos_genes,
        #                          cmu_prs_pos_signaling, "MEF2C"),
        genes_to_label       = mef2c_genes_to_label,
        genes_to_bold        = c("MEF2C"),
        n_top_genes_to_label = 0,
        legend               = TRUE,
        seed                 = 345
    )
)

p_mef2c_ppi <- wrap_plots(ppi_plots) +
    plot_annotation(title = "MEF2C (+) regulon") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box      = "vertical",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 7))

p_mef2c_ppi

ggsave(
    filename = file.path(figures_dir, "supplement", "04_02_MEF2C-PPI.pdf"),
    plot = p_mef2c_ppi,
    height    = 3, 
    width     = 2.75,
    dpi       = 300
)
```
